title: Write a Court-Neutral Incident Note
subtitle: Turn a stressful moment into a documented, share-safe record.
description: A short guided workflow for parents and caregivers who need to document a co-parenting incident in a way that is calm, factual, and usable in a family-court setting. Produces a timestamped note with observable facts, impact on the child, and next steps. **This is educational documentation support, not legal advice.**

jurisdictionTags.scopeNote: General documentation principles apply broadly. Evidentiary rules vary.

steps.title: Safety check
steps.content: Before documenting, confirm you are in a safe space and your child is safe. If there is an immediate danger, pause this playbook and contact your local emergency services.

steps.title: What happened?
steps.content: Capture the facts as you observed them. Stick to what you saw, heard, and what the child said — not interpretations.

expectedInputs.name: childImpact
expectedInputs.label: How did this affect the child?

steps.title: Generate court-neutral rewrite
steps.content: The assistant will convert your notes into a calm, child-centered, court-neutral narrative. Review carefully before saving.

steps.title: Review and edit
steps.content: Check for: names spelled correctly, dates accurate, no accusations or inflammatory language, child's perspective centered.

steps.title: Generate documentation file
steps.content: Produce a timestamped Word document you can save, print, or share with counsel.

artifactTemplates.name: Incident Documentation

additionalDisclosures: Evidentiary admissibility varies by jurisdiction. Consult a licensed attorney for case-specific guidance.

safetyNotes: If the incident involved suspected abuse, do not rely on this playbook alone — contact your local child protective services hotline or a licensed advocate.
